title: Outcome Target Cost Strength
description: Strength of an outcome_target cost_per: the BiddingPolicy.cost_per strength vocabulary, kept identical to it by test. A distinct schema gives generated SDKs a distinct type instead of a second, colliding Strength.

enumDescriptions.cap: Optimize for an average at or below the amount, accepting underdelivery when necessary.
enumDescriptions.target: Optimize around the amount while balancing volume and spend.
